## Key Projects & Case Studies
1. **DuoKart Multi-Tier Cloud Infrastructure (2026)**
   - Resilient multi-tier e-commerce architecture across 2 AZs on AWS us-east-2.
   - Modular 6-tier CloudFormation stacks: VPC, internet-facing ALB, private Auto Scaling EC2 instances, Multi-AZ RDS MySQL, decoupled SQS/DLQ, and Python Lambda workers.
   - Self-healing validated with 100% 200 OK responses during kill-1-EC2 fault injection drills.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/prathameshlonare/duokart
   - Live Architecture & Documentation: https://prathameshlonare.github.io/duokart/

2. **Serverless Online Voting Platform (2025)**
   - 6 AWS Lambda microservices, API Gateway, DynamoDB On-Demand, Cognito multi-role authentication.
   - 500+ active student users served with zero downtime and 180ms P99 latency.
   - Reduced deployment time from 12 mins to 3 mins via GitHub Actions automated CI/CD.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/prathameshlonare/Online-voting-system

3. **Dorm-Dish Multi-Tier AWS Platform (2026)**
   - Serverless accommodation backend with 41 Lambda endpoints, DynamoDB multi-table design, S3 storage, and CloudFront CDN.
   - Achieved 80% cost reduction compared to provisioned EC2 instances.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/prathameshlonare/Dorm-and-Dish

4. **Statement Dashboard PWA (2026)**
   - Offline-first financial statement analyzer running 100% in browser (React 19, pdf.js).
   - Zero server data transmission for privacy-preserving analytics.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/prathameshlonare/statement-dashboard

5. **AI Resume-Job Matcher (2026)**
   - Machine learning classifier (scikit-learn, sentence-transformers) for ATS resume optimization.
   - 95% AUC-ROC score on job relevance classification dataset.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/prathameshlonare/ai-resume-job-matcher
